_comment: Maps country-level covariate columns of the forecasting panel (data/country_panel/ilsa_country_covariates.csv) to predictor groups / domains of the literature knowledge base (outputs/knowledge_base/predictor_evidence.csv). orientation = +1 when a higher covariate value means more of the construct, -1 when reverse-coded. Covariates absent from the panel are ignored. Edit freely; the sign of each prior is taken from the literature, not from this file.

gdp_per_capita_log.description: log GDP per capita (PPP, constant prices)

education_expenditure_pct_gdp.description: Public expenditure on education, % of GDP

escs_mean.description: Country mean of the PISA ESCS index (or IEA home-resources index)

ict_home_access.description: Share of students with a computer / internet at home

self_efficacy_mean.description: Country mean of the domain self-efficacy index

anxiety_mean.description: Country mean of the domain anxiety index

belonging_mean.description: Country mean of sense of belonging / school climate index

teacher_qualification.description: Share of teachers fully certified / with a subject degree

school_resources.description: Index of school educational resources (shortage index → orientation -1)

parental_involvement.description: Country mean of parental involvement / support index
